7863964681.text: Pick marks on the wall suggest someone found something here and stopped digging.

7077683276.text: The crystal in your pocket hums at a frequency that reveals nearby illusions.

8353586922.text: Your next Reflex save benefits from muscle memory you didn't know you had.

138025700.text: A street merchant inexplicably gives you a small discount on your next purchase.
Gain 1 temporary HP at the start of your next combat.

7863964681.text: The servant's entrance is unguarded because the steward is at lunch.

6144366145.text: A turtle blocks a doorway just long enough for you to notice something above it.
Your next Acrobatics check is boosted by surfaces that are less slippery than they look.
A painting hung crooked on the wall hides a wall safe.

7130942567.text: Your next critical failure on a skill check is a regular failure instead.
Your next successful Strike deals 1 extra damage.

7842002561.text: A bouncer at a club recognizes your name and lets you skip the line.

1395063293.text: You recall a mentor's words at exactly the moment they apply.

6023408187.text: An Andoren eagle screams overhead. Your resolve hardens.

7454623139.text: The local currency uses a metal that reacts to magic. Your coins hum near enchantments.
A cook at a roadside stall accidentally makes your portion twice as large.
A conversation in the next room grows heated, masking your movements.

8353586922.text: Your belt pouch has a false bottom you forgot about. Something useful is inside.
Your cloak catches the wind dramatically at a socially advantageous moment.

8117756377.text: The wax seal on your letter is a perfect forgery. Even the recipient's secretary is fooled.
A prayer book contains a pressed flower with mild alchemical properties.

8383886822.text: Torch sconces on the wall are spaced to suggest which path is most traveled.

8787586972.text: The index of an ancient library includes a reference you've never seen catalogued.

5190471248.text: The merchant's scale is off by a hair. In your favor this time.

6144366145.text: The DC of your next skill check is reduced by 1.
Your humming attracts a small animal that's carrying something useful in its mouth.
The vault's combination is the date carved above the entrance. Nobody thought to check.

6717906753.text: A seagull lands on your mast and stays. Sailors say that's extremely lucky.

8770290576.text: The ship's navigator discovers a shorter route that avoids the storm.

8018921976.text: The thing you've been waiting for happens today.

8030796908.text: A travelling merchant owes you a favor they can't quite remember why.

5443237599.text: The next bookshelf you search has its most useful tome at eye level.
The cipher key is printed on the back of a playing card in the deck on the table.
A water barrel in the courtyard provides both cover and a source of drinking water.

8525518483.text: A local dialect word you overhear turns out to be the password you needed.

138025700.text: The ledger has an entry crossed out. The original is still legible underneath.

7454623139.text: A dock worker offers to carry your heaviest item for free. No strings attached.

7130942567.text: The fog lifts for precisely long enough to get your bearings, then descends again.
